description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Duration for the rest of the encounter

Your Static Sense extends across an entire scene or structure for the rest of the encounter.

Your Static floods outward to fill the whole of the current structure, building, or scene, however large. For the duration you know the location of every Anchor-bound hostile within it, whether or not you can see it, and you know the moment a new one enters. You learn positions, not identities — Naming still takes an action and a check.

cinderfall.incomplete: pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/sense.ts:23 confirms Sense's selector field is a closed StringField enum (SENSE_TYPES); no real sense type means 'detect Anchor-bound spirits/ghost-machines specifically'. Additionally, every real Sense rule element takes a fixed numeric range, and 'the whole of the current structure, however large' has no numeric value to supply -- both the selector mismatch and the unbounded range make this unbuildable as a Sense entry.
